# Atilla Guzel

> The personal site of Atilla Guzel, a data scientist and engineer based in London who builds small open-source Python libraries. His subjects are data science, data visualisation, how findings are explained, investigative journalism and the software he builds; so far the posts are mostly about the last.

Every page on this site is hand-written HTML and reads in full without JavaScript.

## Pages

- [Home](https://atillaguzel.github.io/): who Atilla is, the libraries he works on, and where to find him
- [Blog](https://atillaguzel.github.io/blog/): the list of posts, each with its subject
- [Privacy](https://atillaguzel.github.io/privacy/): what the site counts with Google Analytics, what it stores in the browser, and how to turn the counting off

## Posts

- [Writing code got cheap, reading it did not](https://atillaguzel.github.io/blog/writing-code-got-cheap-reading-it-did-not/): Coding agents raised output and slowed review at 655 companies, and what that means for whoever reads the change.
- [An issue is not an instruction](https://atillaguzel.github.io/blog/an-issue-is-not-an-instruction/): How agents can read issues from strangers without taking orders from them.
- [Why this site is written by hand](https://atillaguzel.github.io/blog/why-this-site-is-written-by-hand/): No generator and no build step: what that replaced, and what it costs.
- [pаypal is not paypal](https://atillaguzel.github.io/blog/paypal-is-not-paypal/): Why a unique index does not stop look-alike usernames, and how comparing skeletons does.
- [What a slug has to survive](https://atillaguzel.github.io/blog/what-a-slug-has-to-survive/): Accents, other alphabets and empty results, shown one stage at a time.

## Work

- [sluggi](https://github.com/blip-box/sluggi): a Python library and CLI that turns any text into a clean, URL-safe slug
- [confusable](https://github.com/blip-box/confusable): Unicode spoofing and look-alike detection for Python, following Unicode Technical Standard #39 (alpha)
- [guild](https://github.com/blip-box/guild): agent-run maintenance for open-source libraries, under human stewards (in development)

## Elsewhere

- [GitHub](https://github.com/atillaguzel): Atilla's code
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/atilla-guzel/): the best way to reach him
- [blipbox](https://blipbox.io): where the libraries are presented in full
